## alice-dms-language-check

Shared sub-workflow (PROJ-79): heuristic German-language check with a targeted second
extraction attempt. Called by both alice-dms-processor (nightly) and
alice-dms-language-backfill, so the two never drift apart.

**Input**: { summary, title (optional), extraction_prompt, plaintext }
  - extraction_prompt: the type-specific extraction prompt already used for the 1st attempt
    (already contains the German directive) — reused as the base for the 2nd, stricter attempt.
  - plaintext: original document text, needed to rebuild the prompt for the 2nd attempt.

**Output**: { summary, title, languageUncertain, language_retried, extracted }
  - summary/title: possibly corrected by the 2nd attempt.
  - extracted: full re-parsed JSON object from the 2nd attempt (all fields, not just
    summary/title) — the caller replaces its original `_extracted` with this when a
    retry happened, so the whole record (not just language fields) stays German-consistent.

Heuristic: lightweight local English-word-ratio check (English stopwords / common words vs.
total words) against DMS_LANGUAGE_HEURISTIC_THRESHOLD (default 0.3). Short/name-only texts
(< 6 words) are treated as inconclusive (never flagged) per PROJ-79 edge cases.

2nd attempt stays at temperature 0 (unlike PROJ-78's confidence retry) — the goal is a
stricter instruction, not more variance.
